report:
Fresh reassessment after the unsupported-version test gained the meta.reviews.staleness annotation. Compared every initial fragment and association against the preceding reviewed input: this single annotation is the only initial-input delta; implementation files, claim, remaining test bodies and this anchor's association metadata are unchanged. The new annotation does not change execution or the diagnostic assertions. Re-read all six current test bodies and freshly captured the three helper/context fragments. Prior implementation reasoning remains supported by identical complete captured source files. The claim is unchanged. Inspected all five ordinary implementation entries across review.rs (validate), check.rs (check_reviews, CheckReport, Display), and main.rs (check), including complete associated source files. All six associated tests are ordinary; no TODO/N/A gaps exist. Fixture setup/run/report helpers, the shared Cargo workspace test and library reexports were captured with fresh review reads.

Implementation: validate accumulates every current anchor's missing/unfinished/requested-edits and association errors, preserves malformed/unsupported loader issues, and identifies obsolete records. input_errors includes changed fragment paths/selectors and test/implementation association categories; read_summary and load_saved supply version, identity, parsing and layout reasons. check_reviews preserves all issues and supplies review-skill guidance. CheckReport::ensure_valid, Display and matching Debug render the same failure text for CLI check and Cargo's Result-returning workspace test. Iteration has no early exit; all anchors are represented without needing a redundant multi-anchor formatting test. Checking reads/locks existing files and never invokes start, record or write operations.

Complete test assessment: diagnostics_identify_missing_unfinished_stale_and_requested_edit_reviews asserts CLI failure, anchor and skill for each state, missing/unfinished reason text, stale source filename and edit reason. added_or_removed_associations_invalidate_unchanged_saved_fragments now asserts rendered library failure, anchor, skill and test/implementation association categories for added/removed tests and added implementation, preserving original inventory comparisons. unsupported_versions_and_mismatched_identity_cannot_pass asserts anchor and skill plus unsupported-version or identity-mismatch reasons through ensure_valid. completed_corrupt_records_and_invalid_layout_cannot_pass asserts library/CLI failure and anchor/skill/invalid-validation text plus specific parse, blank-field, unknown-field, missing-file, and directory reasons across all nine existing scenarios. These tests detect generic-message regressions previously uncovered. retired_records_fail_even_when_every_remaining_anchor_passes checks named obsolete failure/removal guidance, retains output until explicit deletion, then passes. checking_is_read_only_and_recording_preserves_obsolete_records proves missing validation storage stays absent, normal records remain byte-identical after CLI/library checks, and obsolete records survive failure and unrelated recording. Combined with the shared rendering call graph, these tests cover the full claim without duplicating each case per CLI and Cargo surface.

Execution distinction: in this refresh I executed review start, read, source-input comparison and record only; no source edits or behavior tests. My earlier run before the annotation-only delta passed all 31 review integration tests and cargo build after cargo fmt. The coordinator now reports 331 sage-meta functional tests, 46 sage-stash tests and workspace build passing; those are externally reported results, not runs performed in this refresh. The additional test association does not weaken any assertion. All claim requirements remain accounted for and no edits are requested.
